::: {.side-panel}
### Keep your work together

[Create a task issue →](https://github.com/Donggyurim/neuroimaging-training/issues/new?template=student-task.yml){.action-link .primary-action}

[Find my assigned tasks →](https://github.com/Donggyurim/neuroimaging-training/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+assignee%3A%40me)

GitHub sign-in and repository access may be needed. Assign the issue to yourself and link your draft PR.
:::

::: {.side-panel}
### Before your next meeting

- What did you try?
- What evidence do you have?
- What is blocking you?
- What decision do you need?

Add a short update to your task issue. Keep participant data and private feedback in approved storage.
:::

::: {.side-panel .soft-panel}
### Stuck? Start small.

Share the command, error message, software version, and what you expected. Remove sensitive details first.

[Get setup help](tutorials/getting-started.qmd#when-something-goes-wrong) · [Browse lessons](library.qmd)
:::
:::
